TERMS & CONDITIONS

Last updated: June 2026

1. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS
By using Astro Key you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please uninstall the app.

2. USE OF THE APP
Astro Key is provided for personal, non-commercial use only. You may not use the app for any unlawful purpose.

3. DATA STORAGE
All data you enter — birth charts, events, notes — is stored locally on your device. We do not collect, access, or transmit your personal data to any external server.

4. ACCURACY OF ASTROLOGICAL DATA
Astro Key uses the Swiss Ephemeris library for planetary calculations, which provides highly accurate astronomical positions. Astrological interpretations are for personal reflection and entertainment purposes only. We make no claims regarding the accuracy or validity of astrological predictions.

5. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All content, design, and code in Astro Key is the intellectual property of the developer. You may not copy, modify, or redistribute any part of the application.

6. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
The app is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. The developer is not liable for any damages arising from your use of the app.

7. CHANGES TO TERMS
We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.

8. CONTACT
For questions: kastroguru@gmail.com

PRIVACY POLICY

Last updated: June 2026

1. OVERVIEW
Astro Key is designed with privacy as a core principle. All data is stored locally on your device and never transmitted to external servers.

2. DATA WE STORE
The app stores only data you explicitly enter:
- Names and birth dates for astrological charts
- Geographic locations used for chart calculations
- Personal diary entries and event notes
- App settings and preferences

3. HOW WE USE YOUR DATA
Your data is used solely to calculate and display astrological charts and diary entries within the app. It is never used for advertising, analytics, or any other purpose.

4. DATA SHARING
We do not sell, share, or transmit your data to any third party under any circumstances.

5. DATA STORAGE
All data is stored in a local SQLite database on your device. Android's Auto Backup feature may sync this database to your Google account — this is controlled entirely by your Android device settings and Google's own privacy policy.

6. YOUR RIGHTS
You can view, edit, or delete any of your data at any time from within the app. Uninstalling the app removes all locally stored data.

7. CHILDREN'S PRIVACY
This app is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

8. CONTACT
For privacy questions: kastroguru@gmail.com

GDPR & DATA USAGE

Last updated: June 2026

1. DATA CONTROLLER
The data controller for Astro Key is:
Kastro Guru
Email: kastroguru@gmail.com

2. LEGAL BASIS FOR PROCESSING
Your data is processed on the basis of your explicit consent, given when you enter it into the app (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR).

3. WHAT DATA IS PROCESSED
- Names (may be real or fictional — your choice)
- Birth dates and times
- Geographic locations (city, country, coordinates)
- Personal diary entries and event notes

4. PURPOSE OF PROCESSING
Data is processed solely to calculate and display astrological charts for your personal use within the app.

5. DATA RETENTION
Your data is retained on your device until you delete it. You can delete individual entries or all data from within the app at any time.

6. YOUR GDPR RIGHTS
As a user in the EU you have the following rights:

- Right of access: all your data is always visible within the app.
- Right to rectification: you can edit any entry at any time.
- Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten"): you can delete any or all entries at any time.
- Right to data portability: use the export feature to obtain a copy of your data.
- Right to object: you may stop using the app and delete all data at any time.
- Right to withdraw consent: uninstalling the app constitutes withdrawal of consent.

7. DATA TRANSFERS
This app does not transfer your data outside your device. If you have enabled Android Auto Backup, data may be stored in your Google account and is subject to Google's own privacy policy.

8. COMPLAINTS
If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority.

9. CONTACT
For GDPR requests: kastroguru@gmail.com
Import saved birth charts from astro.com

1. Log in to astro.com and go to My Astro → Stored Astro Data.

2. Click the AAF button to switch the list to AAF export format.

3. Select and copy all lines beginning with #A93: (you can select and copy the entire page).

4. Paste the copied text into the field below and tap Import.
